Author: Lumina
Message:
feat(N2): richer model metadata, size classes, and risk-relevant fields

Coordination card f942d93b. Adds params_b, active_params_b, size_class
(the Joule Economy S/M/L/XL enum, verbatim), latency_class, reasoning,
structured_outputs, and min_output_tokens to model cards, plus a
per-provider data_retention posture block with dated ToS verification.

Store placement (no parallel store introduced):
- params_b/active_params_b/size_class/latency_class/reasoning/
  structured_outputs/min_output_tokens/providers.*.data_retention live in
  config/model-cards.overrides.yaml, the existing curated overlay. New
  module src/discovery/model-size.mjs holds the shared id-string parser
  (parseParamsFromId, parseParamsFromDescription) and the size_class
  threshold function, used by both nvidia.mjs and openrouter.mjs so the
  heuristic derivation lives in one place, not two hand-synced copies.
- src/discovery/providers/nvidia.mjs normalize() now also emits numeric
  params_b/active_params_b and a heuristic size_class off the id string it
  already parses, still tagged source:'heuristic'.
- src/discovery/providers/openrouter.mjs surfaces the reasoning and
  structured_outputs booleans OpenRouter already declares in
  supported_parameters and was discarding, plus a best-effort params_b/
  active_params_b/size_class from the id string or, when the id carries no
  size token, from the provider's own description prose (measured: the
  live "nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning:free" id has no size token at all
  but its description states "3B active parameters out of 30B total").
  Tagged params_basis so the guess is distinguishable from the rest of the
  provider-declared card.
- src/discovery/providers/opencode.mjs surfaces reasoning/
  structured_outputs directly from models.dev's own declaration.
  params_b/active_params_b/size_class stay null there: models.dev's
  opencode registry carries no parameter field and Zen's ids (big-pickle,
  nemotron-3-ultra-free, nemotron-3.5-lightning-free) carry no size token,
  so there is nothing honest to derive.
- src/ranking/capabilities.mjs adds three DERIVED-AT-READ-TIME fields,
  never persisted: capabilities.size_class (surfaced off the card),
  capabilities.trust_zone (0 sovereign / 1 contractual paid-cloud /
  2 exposed free-remote, folding sovereignty with an injected
  opts.providers posture map), and capabilities.throughput_tps (injected
  metric, null until the joule epic's recordResponse fix lands).
- New src/discovery/provider-posture.mjs loads the overlay's providers:
  block for capabilities.mjs's opts.providers. Not wired into the live
  router.mjs call site by this card: that file is out of scope here
  (concurrent work, card N1's job to enforce a zone ceiling).

data_retention verified 2026-08-15: anthropic contractual-zero (commercial
terms Section B, "may not train on Customer Content"); nvidia and opencode
trains (opencode.ai/docs/zen quotes NVIDIA's own free-tier trial banner
and Zen's own free-model data-use notice); openrouter trains as the
fail-safe assumption for its free tier (its own docs decline to state a
policy and defer to the per-routed-provider table); local is local-only,
architectural rather than a ToS claim needing a date.

Coverage: NVIDIA's raw catalog (79 live ids) gets params_b/size_class for
every id whose id string carries a "-<N>b" size token; ids with none
(most "-thinking"/"-instruct"-only ids) stay null, honestly, matching the
card's own "59 of 102 absent from models.dev" ground truth. OpenRouter's
16 live free ids get it from the id or the description fallback.
OpenCode Zen currently reports 0 live ids in the local discovery cache
(a pre-existing fetch-path issue, not touched here); its 62 ids are live
when queried directly.

npm test: 990 tests, 989 pass, 1 fail (same pre-existing
"SIEM live hook - happy path" failure present on main before this
branch, in router.mjs territory, untouched here). Baseline was 947/946/1.
